# TechDova

TechDova is a demo tech e-commerce storefront ("Your tech universe" /
"Votre univers technologique"). It is a fully static demonstration site:
there is no backend, no database, no checkout processing and no real
commerce. Nothing on this site can be bought, paid for or delivered.

## Demo-data disclaimer

All products, prices, discounts, ratings, review counts, stock levels,
testimonials, blog posts and delivery copy are fictional demo content
created for illustration. The cart, checkout, contact form, newsletter,
account, wishlist and order-tracking flows run entirely in the visitor's
browser (localStorage) and send nothing anywhere. Contact details shown
on the site are placeholders.

## Brand and locales

- Brand: TechDova
- Site: https://techdova.pages.dev/
- Locales: English (en) and French (fr). Every page exists in both
  locales under a required locale prefix, e.g. /en/shop and /fr/shop.
  English is the default locale.

## Catalogue facts

- 12 products across 6 categories: smartphones, computers, audio, smartwatches, gaming, accessories.
- Prices are stored as plain numbers in Algerian dinars (DZD) and displayed with a "DA" suffix (e.g. "999.00 DA" in English, "999,00 DA" in French).
- Delivery is free on all orders in this demo, within 24/48h. Returns are accepted within 30 days (demo policy).
